title: Reverse Pivot Shift
note: Generated by tools/figures.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification and source fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. A figure the reviewer corrects or deletes is marked REMOVED rather than removed from this file.

figures.claim: Position the patient supine and relaxed, with the knee flexed to about seventy degrees or more and the foot held in your hand.
The shift occurs as the knee passes about twenty to thirty degrees of flexion, where the iliotibial band changes from a flexor to an extensor of the knee and pulls the lateral plateau forward.

An increase in external rotation at thirty degrees of flexion and at ninety degrees in the same knee points the same way and is easier to grade, which is why the dial test is usually the test that settles it.
